name: Rclone Mount
short_desc: Encrypted cloud storage mounted into Runtipi media
author: rclone
description: Rclone provides a protected web interface for configuring cloud remotes and mounts one configured remote at the shared Runtipi media path /cloud.

form_fields.label: GUI username
form_fields.hint: Username protecting both the web interface and the internal remote-control endpoint.

form_fields.label: GUI password
form_fields.hint: Password protecting both the web interface and the internal remote-control endpoint.

form_fields.label: Mounted remote
form_fields.hint: Remote and optional path to mount at /cloud, for example encrypted: or encrypted:media. Create this remote in the GUI, then restart the app.

form_fields.label: VFS cache size
form_fields.pattern_error: Enter a positive size such as 50G, 500Gi or 1T.
form_fields.hint: Maximum local disk space used to cache cloud reads and writes. Open files can temporarily exceed this limit.
